claims.claim: TSMC's October 2026 consolidated revenue was about USD 17.61 billion (NT$586.89 billion), up 59.7 percent year on year and 14.7 percent from September.
claims.episode_span: October consolidated revenue of NT$586.89 billion, which ANI put at 17.61 billion dollars, up 59.7 percent
claims.source_title: TSMC October revenue surges 59.7% YoY to USD 17.61 billion
claims.supporting_quote: On a consolidated basis, revenue for October 2026 was approximately NT$586.89 billion, an increase of 14.7 per cent from September 2026 and an increase of 59.7 per cent from October 2025.

claims.claim: TSMC's prior monthly revenue record was NT$514.81 billion in August, and October was about 23.8 trillion won.
claims.episode_span: cleared the prior monthly record, August's NT$514.81 billion, and puts October near 23.8 trillion won
claims.source_title: TSMC October Revenue Hits 23.8 Trillion Won, a Monthly Record
claims.supporting_quote: The previous record was revenue of 514.81 billion New Taiwan dollars in August (about 20.9 trillion won).

claims.claim: TSMC's fourth-quarter revenue forecast is $52.3 billion to $54.3 billion, with a midpoint of $53.3 billion that is 58 percent above the year-ago quarter and 14 percent above the prior quarter.
claims.episode_span: fourth-quarter forecast remains 52.3 billion to 54.3 billion dollars; the midpoint, 53.3 billion, is 58 percent above the year-ago quarter
claims.source_title: TSMC October Revenue Hits 23.8 Trillion Won, a Monthly Record
claims.supporting_quote: The midpoint of the forecast, $53.3 billion, is 58% higher than the same quarter last year and 14% higher than the previous quarter.

claims.claim: TSMC's 2-nanometer process has entered mass-production ramp, and the company expects 2026-2028 capital spending to be substantially higher than the prior three years.
claims.episode_span: the 2-nanometer process has entered mass-production ramp
claims.source_title: AI Chip Boom... TSMC October Revenue Surges 60% Year Over Year
claims.supporting_quote: The next-generation 2-nanometer process has also entered the ramp-up phase of mass production.

claims.claim: Alex Deucher submitted eight Linux patches on November 9 adding GFX13 support, more than 12,600 lines, naming GFX 13.0.1 and GFX 13.0.4.
claims.episode_span: eight patches on November 9 that add GFX13 support
claims.source_title: AMD's RDNA 5 Inches Closer as GFX13 Support Lands in Linux Driver Patches
claims.supporting_quote: These patches, submitted to the mailing list on November 9 by AMDGPU maintainer Alex Deucher, contain over 12,600 lines of code, excluding the typically large header files.

claims.claim: Fraunhofer IPMS demonstrated quasi-monolithic integration of chiplets into a silicon wafer for the first time, and its hafnium-oxide ferroelectric memories switch below one volt in the nanosecond range.
claims.episode_span: has for the first time integrated chiplets into pockets in a silicon wafer
claims.source_title: Fraunhofer IPMS Highlights Semiconductor Technology Developments at SEMICON Europa
claims.supporting_quote: Within the APECS pilot line, Fraunhofer IPMS has demonstrated for the first time that chiplets can be integrated into a silicon wafer using this method.

claims.claim: Cimarron at Oklahoma State provides 37,760 processor cores, 392 GPUs, and more than 10 petabytes of storage and is available to researchers in Oklahoma, Arkansas, and Kansas.

claims.supporting_quote: Operated by OSU’s High Performance Computing Center (HPCC), Cimarron provides 37,760 processor cores, 392 GPUs and more than 10 petabytes of storage.
